name: Next Generation Science Standards
summary: K-12 science standards, adopted or adapted by many U.S. states.

license.note: States, districts, schools, teachers and non-profit education entities may copy and adapt them without permission. A commercial user needs to look further, and the name NGSS has its own rules.

cite: NGSS Lead States (2013). Next Generation Science Standards: For States, By States. National Academies Press.

fits.how: A standard for an activity, in a teacher’s own words or through a standards search.

connect.note: Listed. A teacher can write a standard into a goal; the search here finds what Learning Commons carries.
